{{Quote|Admiral, we're taking fire, should we turn around?|The pilot's last words|<ref name="Episode VIII" />}}
A [[human]] '''pilot''' served in the [[Resistance]] [[Resistance navy|fleet]] during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]].<ref name="Episode VIII" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date Note" /> during the [[Battle of Oetchi]] he [[pilot]]ed a [[U-55 orbital loadlifter]], and, after witnessing the destruction of two other transports at the hands of the [[Supreme Leader]]'s [[Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Supremacy]]'' asked [[Vice Admiral]] [[Amilyn Holdo]] whether to turn back or press forward. As Holdo desperately told him to push full-speed ahead to the [[planet]] [[Crait]], the [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] and his transport were hit and destroyed.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pilot first appeared in a [[hologram]] in the 2017 film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|Star Wars: Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] and was portrayed by an uncredited actor.<ref name="Episode VIII" />
